name: PlantDoc: Plant Disease Detection in Natural Field Conditions
description: A field-condition computer vision dataset for plant disease detection developed by researchers at the Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Kharagpur. Unlike laboratory leaf collections, PlantDoc contains 2,598 high-resolution images captured in natural, unconstrained field environments with complex backgrounds, multiple overlapping leaves, and realistic agricultural lighting conditions. Features 8,851 manual bounding box annotations across 27 classes representing 13 plant species.
